g.text: 365 nm LED held at constant optical power by a photodiode loop in the MCU. I2C target 0x2A, 5 V in.

g.desc: 365 nm LED held at constant optical power by a photodiode loop in the MCU. I2C target 0x2A, 5 V in.

g.text: LED current: I = (V_gate - V_GS) / R1, at most (5 V - V_f) / 3.9 R = 0.33 A (hardware limit).

g.text: J2 goes to the LED star through the UV ARM toggle switch (in the LED+ wire, on the housing).
